title: Canonicalize halfling subrace records for Lightfoot and Stout lookups
description:
## Problem

The SRD source headings use bare subrace names Lightfoot and Stout, and the parser currently preserves those names directly. The emitter then derives canonical record keys and display names from ancestry.name, producing records like:

- ancestry:lightfoot
- ancestry:stout

That is source-faithful, but weak for canonical lookup. A user/player request for Lightfoot
close_reason: Canonicalized bare SRD halfling subrace headings to Lightfoot Halfling and Stout Halfling record names/keys while preserving Halfling parent linkage; verification passed: npm run typecheck, touched-file Biome CI, npm run test.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Worktree baseline: npm install -> succeeded; npm run typecheck -> passed; npx vitest run packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseAncestries.test.ts packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/pipeline.test.ts -> passed (47 tests).

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Debugging evidence: parseAncestries maps SRD halfling subrace headings Lightfoot and Stout into AncestryExtraction.name unchanged; emit.ts keys records via ancestryKey(ancestry.name), so the emitted records become ancestry:lightfoot and ancestry:stout. Root cause hypothesis: source heading text and canonical record display/key text are sharing one field; halfling subraces need a deterministic canonicalization step while retaining parent linkage to Halfling.
